title: Weekday cake pickup from 6am for Box Hill and Riverstone commuters
summary:
Collecting a birthday cake before work in Box Hill or Riverstone? Our Riverstone Shopping Centre store opens at 6:00 AM Monday to Friday.

That matters if your cake is for the office, a school morning or a lunchtime celebration. Pick it up on the way to the Riverstone train station or the drive out, instead of rearranging your afternoon around a 5pm cut-off.

Custom eggless cakes need 2 days notice. Send your design and the pickup time you want, and we confirm it. 8-inch from $49.99, serves 12-14. Free parking at the centre.

No eggs. Nothing for the office to ask about.

Send your design: numnumsbakery.com.au/#order
